cards.imageAlt: Figure 28，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Can you describe what is happening in the picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能描述图中正在发生什么吗？
cards.referenceText: I think the flight must be experiencing a severe turbulence and cabin depressurization, because we can see there is a gaping hole in the rear fuselage and the tail has been lost. The passenger oxygen masks have dropped down and some passengers have been injured badly. Furthermore, a passenger is being sucked out of the gaping hole in the right picture. It is a terrible accident.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这架飞机肯定正在经历严重颠簸和机舱失压，因为在机身后段有个张开的洞，机尾已经消失。乘客的氧气面罩已自动落下，有些乘客受伤很严重。此外，右图中一位乘客被吸出洞外，这是场很可怕的事故。

cards.audioText: What may lead to cabin depressurization?
cards.audioTextZh: 机舱失压为什么会发生？
cards.referenceText: Depressurization can arise as a result of a mechanical failure of the pressurization system, or if, in an unlikely event of a terrorist sabotage, an in-flight explosive decompression. It can also be caused by metal fatigue in older planes. More often, depressurization comes about in an insidious manner as pressure leak out quite slowly, which we call slow depressurization.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机舱失压可能由于增压系统出现机械故障，或有很小概率是由于飞行中恐怖分子进行破坏，炸弹爆炸导致机舱失压，还有可能因为老旧飞机金属疲劳引发机舱失压。更多时候，失压并不是突然发生的，压力缓慢漏出，这种情况被称为缓慢失压。

cards.audioText: What should a pilot do in the case of cabin depressurization?
cards.audioTextZh: 在机舱失压的情况下飞行员应该怎样做？
cards.referenceText: The first thing to do is to retain consciousness and maintain control of the airplane. Then the pilot should follow the Standard Operation Procedures (SOP) and initiate an emergency descent. He should also contact ATC and tell them their intentions. The oxygen masks will be down for pilots, flight attendants and passengers, and the pilot should ask the passengers to fasten their seat belts.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先要保持意识清醒，保持对飞机的控制。然后飞行员要遵循标准操作流程，做紧急下降，同时飞行员应联系ATC并告知意图。氧气面罩会为飞行员、乘务员和乘客自动落下，飞行员应要求乘客系紧安全带。

cards.audioText: What should the passengers do in the case of cabin depressurization?
cards.audioTextZh: 在机舱失压的情况下乘客应该怎样做？
cards.referenceText: The passengers should pay more attention to the usage of oxygen demonstration prior to departure. Once the depressurization happens, they must quickly grab the nearest oxygen mask, pull it towards themselves to start the oxygen supply and don it onto face securely.
cards.referenceTextZh: 乘客在起飞前应注意氧气面罩的使用示范。一旦发生机舱失压，乘客要迅速拿到最近的氧气面罩，将氧气面罩戴上，然后面罩开始提供氧气。

cards.audioText: Why is the cabin pressurization essential for a flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行中，为什么机舱加压至关重要？
cards.referenceText: When flying at certain altitude, outside atmospheric pressure is low. To maintain a safe and comfortable environment for crew and passengers, cabin pressurization is needed by the active pumping of compressed air into an aircraft cabin.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当飞行到一定高度时，飞机外部的大气压力较低。为了给机组和乘客提供安全舒适的环境，需要用泵将空气压缩进飞机机舱。

cards.audioText: Have you encountered depressurization in your flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行中，你曾遭遇过机舱失压吗？
cards.referenceText: No. I have been a pilot for more than ten years and I have never encountered such situation. But I have the experience of depressurization in simulator training. / Yes, I have the experience of depressurization in flight. Last summer I flew to Shanghai. During climbing, I encountered cabin depressurization. It was horrible. I forced myself to keep calm and maintain the control of the airplane. With the assistance of the whole flight crew members, I handled the situation and we finally landed safely. It was a terrible experience but I learnt much from it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，成为一名飞行员已超过十年，我从未遭遇过这种情况，但是在模拟训练中我有机舱失压的经验。/ 有，我曾遭遇过机舱失压。去年夏天，飞往上海途中，飞机上升时遭遇了机舱失压。情况非常可怕，我强迫自己冷静下来并保持对飞机的控制。在所有机组成员的协助下，我处理了情况最后安全着陆。这段经历很恐怖，但是从中我学到了很多。
